features.quote: A bell-shaped cistern (7.0 X 5.5 m, depth 4.0 m)

date.basis: not dated; Byzantine sherds are reported from the church, not the cistern

features.quote: two long, narrow spaces which had been roofed with stone vaults

date.basis: not dated; identification with Eudoxia's reservoir is attributed to Schneider and no date is given

features.quote: A settling basin has been preserved in the northwest corner

notes: Reservoir B is coded as a pit, not a pool, because the publication says its two spaces were roofed with stone vaults (PROTOCOL.md section 3). Its position, 'about 15 m north of the ancient road' (p. 81), is from the road, so relative_to 'other'. The settling basin lies 'in the northwest corner' of the reservoir, also relative_to 'other'; it is a bare basin with no size, so pool_def 'unclear'. The bell-shaped cistern is in the atrium of church A, with no direction from the site. No plan position: the plan (p. 81) has a north arrow and scale, but the unit's recorded point (publication map ref. 17675/13495) is not marked and cannot be placed on it. The plan's unlabelled dashed oval inside A (about 7 m across) probably draws the cistern; it adds nothing. No passage on burials; silence is not an absence statement.
